svg.title: D12 Security and trust boundaries
svg.text: AUTHENTICATED CALLERS · JWT / HMAC / SIGNED MAVLINK
TENANT BOUNDARY · ORGANIZATION_ID ON EVERY ROW
edge protection (WAF / DDoS): provider-side, not in repo — proposed
TLS · JWT exp + sub required · alg=none rejected · Argon2 · DB re-check every request · HMAC ±5 min · MAVLink-2 signing
foreign ids → 404 · tenant never taken from the wire · cross-tenant probe over the route table
rate-limit policies (fail-closed for ingest, webhook, LISA, admin) · security headers · CORS allow-list · 25 MB body
TLS in transit at the edge; KMS / CMK
HTTP push uses a tenant JWT; per-device machine
OEM pull: HTTPS only, public IPs, no redirects (SSRF
four-eyes approval for expansive tenant changes;
no vault / rotation tooling in repo
separate credentials and restore drill required
